Subsystem is 1948:3ab5 according to [http://www.modem-help.co.uk/AirLink101/AWLC4030-Super-G-Wireless-Cardbus-Adapter.html modem-help]. Drivers additionally list 1948:3ab8 as an additional Cardbus model (modem-help [http://www.modem-help.co.uk/AirLink101/AWLC4030-II-Super-G-Wireless-Cardbus-Adapter.html lists this as the AWLC4030-II]). FCC ID listed in modem-help and [http://madwifi-project.org/wiki/Compatibility/AirLink the madwifi wiki] as KA22003090016-1.. but 3ab8 is incuded in with that.
Device is definitely an Alpha Networks device.
